The '''Kothlis Starport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. 
==Geography==
It was located west of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] and was the westernmost station of [["The Loop" (unirail)|"The Loop"]] [[monorail/Legends|unirail]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The area around the starport was one of the cleanest, most decorated and better guarded areas of the city. The building featured many colorful artworks. Guard patrols kept beggars and suspicious-looking characters away so that passengers felt safe and unpestered.<ref name="guide" />

Most of Kothlis' light industry was concentrated around the starport.

==Functions==
The starport was busy at all time, crowded by all types of businessbeings. It served the colony's economy as it imported supplies, and the planetary corporations exported their goods to the [[the galaxy/Legends|galactic]] markets. An aditional modified cargo line connected the starport with the [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]].<ref name="guide" />

A [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] could fit in one berth, while larger ships could occupy two or more. Docking costed 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] with five more per day of stay, providing refuelling, [[Life support/Legends]] recharging and minor repairs.<ref name="guide" />

Passengers could hire a [[Service droid/Legends|servant droid]] for one credit per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] to push their [[Repulsorcart/Legends|repulsorcart]]s.<ref name="guide" />
==Layout==
[[file:talcarastarportlayout.jpg|thumb|A map of the starport]]
The starport was a circular building, from which eight docking berth pylons spread out. The edge of the circle was surrounded by a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] concourse, an elevated walkway 10 [[meter/Legends|meters]] above ground, providing benches and a view to the docking berths.<ref name="guide" />

The center of the starport was occupied by a dome-shaped building, the main terminal, housing a [[holoboard/Legends|holoboard]] with the schedules, local item gift shops, the ''[[Jaded Jawa]]'' [[cantina/Legends|bar]], and posh waiting rooms with [[Holoprojector/Legends|Holoprojectors]].<ref name="guide" />

Triangular areas to the northeast and southwest, served as passenger terminals, where droids sold tickets, also housing less luxurious waiting rooms. The southeastern area (facing the pylons reserved to cargo ships) was the cargo terminal, off-limits to other personnel.<ref name="guide" />

The eight pylons surrounding the starport contained fifteen docking births each (numbering starting with the eastern pylon), totalling 120. The three southeastern pylons (housing berths #1-45) were dedicated to cargo transfers, whose cargo utilized the commercial unirail line towards the warehouse district. Berths #95-104 on the northern pylon were permanently reserved for the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] of [[Beldonna's League]], [[Consul-General]] [[Gilad Halsek]]'s hired mercenaries. The last berth, #120, was permanently reserved for [[Gilad Halsek's Lambda-class shuttle]].<ref name="guide" />
